name: An Anxious Brother
description: Elian, the villager, seems deeply troubled. Perhaps if I prove myself as a capable person, he might trust me with what's wrong.

1.name: Talk to Elian
1.description: Elian is often seen muttering to himself near the village square. I should try to speak with him.

fail_response.content: I... I can't talk right now. I'm sorry. I have too much on my mind.
